content:
After winning 20 awards at the two-night Creative Arts Emmys last week, Apple TV added 9 more tonight at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards. Here's the full list of winners.

  • Kate O'Flynn, Best Supporting Actress in a Comedy Series
  • Stephen Root, Best Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series
  • Matthew Rhys, Best Actor in a Comedy Series
  • Katie Dippold, Best Writing for a Comedy Series
  • Hiro Murai, Best Directing for a Comedy Series
  • Best Comedy Series
  • Rhea Seehorn, Best Actress in a Drama Series
  • Vince Gilligan, Best Writing for a Drama Series
  • Saul Metzstein, Best Directing for a Drama Series

When presenting the Best Comedy Series award, Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson also took the opportunity to promote their upcoming Apple TV comedy 《Brothers》, which plays on the long-running rumour that the two might be half-brothers.

Apple CEO John Ternus also attended the ceremony and showed off the new iPhone Duo in an interview with Deadline.

With tonight's awards, Apple has won a record-breaking 29 awards at the 78th Emmy Awards, including Best Advertisement for its commercial 《I'm Not Remarkable》.

《Widow's Bay》 alone swept 14 Emmy Awards, surpassing last year's record of 13 awards for 《The Studio》. Both series achieved this feat in their debut season.

In addition to Apple TV's wins, other winners at tonight's ceremony included:

  • Best Actress in a Comedy Series: Jean Smart, 《Hacks》
  • Best Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie: Matthew Rhys, 《The Beast in Me》
  • Best Supporting Actress in a Drama Series: Allison Janney, 《The Diplomat》
  • Best Reality Competition Programme: 《The Traitors》
  • Best Actor in a Drama Series: Noah Wyle, 《The Pitt》
  • Best Supporting Actor in a Drama Series: Tom Pelphrey, 《Task》
  • Best Actress in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie: Sally Field, 《Remarkably Bright Creatures》
  • Best Variety Series: 《The Late Show with Stephen Colbert》
  • Best Limited or Anthology Series: 《DTF St. Louis》
  • Best Drama Series: 《The Pitt》

Apple TV costs US$14.99 per month, or you can opt for the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a wide range of hit series and films, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》 and 《Silo》, among others.
